# netbox_power_panel (Data Source)

Retrieves a single power panel from NetBox. The lookup fails if no match or more than one match is found.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_power_panel" "example" {
  name    = "example"
  site_id = 1
}

output "power_panel_id" {
  value = data.netbox_power_panel.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the power panel.

### Optional

- `site_id` (Number) The ID of the site associated with the power panel.

### Read-Only

- `comments` (String) Free-form comments about the power panel.
- `created` (String) When the power panel was created.
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values of the power panel, as a map of field name to value.
- `description` (String) A description of the power panel.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `last_updated` (String) When the power panel was last changed.
- `location_id` (Number) The ID of the location associated with the power panel.
- `owner_id` (Number) The ID of the owner associated with the power panel.
- `powerfeed_count` (Number) The number of powerfeed objects that refer to the power panel.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags assigned to the object, by name.
